[element-patent]
=== `<patent>` Patent Number (in a citation)

In a bibliographic citation (<<element-element-citation,`<element-citation>`>> or <<element-mixed-citation,`<mixed-citation>`>>) or a citation to a related object (<<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>>), this element holds identification information for a patent.

#### Attributes

* <<attribute-content-type,`@content-type`>>
* <<attribute-country,`@country`>>
* <<attribute-specific-use,`@specific-use`>>
#### Base Attributes

* <<attribute-id,`@id`>>
* <<attribute-xml-base,`@xml:base`>>
* <<attribute-xml-lang,`@xml:lang`>>

#### Models and Context

#### May be contained in

<<element-element-citation,`<element-citation>`>>, <<element-mixed-citation,`<mixed-citation>`>>, <<element-nlm-citation,`<nlm-citation>`>>, <<element-related-article,`<related-article>`>>, <<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>>
#### Description

Text, numbers, or special characters, zero or more
#### Content Model

[source,xml]
....
<!ELEMENT  patent       (#PCDATA %patent-elements;)*                 >
....
#### Expanded Content Model

(#PCDATA)*

#### Tagged Sample

##### In a citation of type “patent”

<mixed-citation publication-type="patent"
  publication-format="print"
 ><person-group person-group-type="inventor"

 <source>Cryptographic Method and Apparatus 
  for Public Key Exchange with Authentications</source>, 
 <patent country="US">U.S, Patent no. 4,956,863</patent>, 
 <month>Sept.</month> <day>11</day>, 
 <year>1990</year>.</mixed-citation>
...
....
